title: Filter Pressure Rise Before Clean
dataSources: Hot Spring sessions (`hotspring:session`), spa chemistry logs (`spa:chemistry`), filter maintenance records (`spa:filter`), and spa energy usage (`spa:energy`).
app: Hot Spring session logs, spa chemistry test results, filter maintenance records, and energy consumption telemetry streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=spa:filter filter_id=* pressure_psi=* days_since_clean=*
| where pressure_psi>=25 OR days_since_clean>30
| sort - pressure_psi
| table filter_id pressure_psi days_since_clean filter_status
description: Flags spa filters with pressure at or above twenty-five PSI or not cleaned in thirty days.
value: High filter pressure reduces circulation and makes the heater work harder, raising energy bills.
implementation: Track `pressure_psi` and `days_since_clean` on each filter reading and clean when pressure rises.
visualization: Gauge of filter pressure with days-since-clean overlay.
grandmaExplanation: It watches spa filters that are clogged enough they probably need cleaning now.
